name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Dark Sky
description: Deep, smooth, and built to unwind. The Cheech & Chong Dark Sky D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy. Dark Sky brings a rich, after-hours profile: dark berry and stone fruit sweetness up front, layered with earthy depth and a smooth, subtly gassy finish. It's a full-bodied, mellow flavor made for late nights and slow evenings. Why you'll love it: 2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance Signature Dark Sky flavor — dark berry and stone fruit with earthy, gassy depth Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Dark Sky is ready whenever you are. For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
